name: Claudia Clement
original_name: クラウディア・クレメント
source:
A witch who is Marie's senior apprentice.
She is also Marie's childhood friend and lived near her house in a witch's village in Germany.
She is a strange person who dreams of serving the devil and establishing a dark secret organization to conquer the world.
Her body, full of adult charm, attracts the attention of men all over the world, but her pointlessly high-spirited and unconventional behavior quickly causes them to look away.
